_meta.description: VIEWER-masked VehicleState snapshot from GET /api/vehicles/{vehicleId}/snapshot, for a caller holding a share grant rather than ownership. The same car and the same moment as snapshot.json (the owner view) so the two can be diffed field-for-field. Added by MYR-435 (client decision 2026-08-02: 'Remove media/cabin and any vehicle controls'), which replaced the owner-minus-vin subtraction mask with an explicit viewer allow-list after the MYR-427 privacy audit found that subtraction masks rot -- every field added to the owner list reached viewers by default. WHAT IS ABSENT IS THE POINT: this document carries no interiorTemp, no exteriorTemp, no media/now-playing field, and no vehicle-controls state (locked, chargePortDoorOpen, frunkOpen, trunkOpen, virtualKeyPaired), and it carries no `vin` (MYR-279). Absent, not nulled -- the KEY is gone, because emitting null would still tell the viewer the field exists (rest-api.md section 5.1). Note that interiorTemp and exteriorTemp were moved OUT of vehicle-state.schema.json's `required` list in the same change: this fixture validating against VehicleState IS the proof that a masked viewer document is still valid against the shape its own consumer decodes, which is the defect MYR-184 hit when the viewer mask stripped the required `name`. Consumers with generated non-optional bindings must regenerate -- see rest-api.md section 5.2.1.2. The canonical field-by-field enumeration lives in rest-api.md section 5.2.1.1.
